title: 第1章 沙漏觉醒，矿洞斩敌
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
黑。

    伸手不见五指的黑。

    苏余是被胸腔里火辣辣的疼给逼醒的。

    他咳了一声，嘴里全是铁锈味的血沫子，混着煤渣，黏在舌根上。

    头顶是塌方的碎石，背后是冰凉的岩壁。

    他想起来了——西三矿洞，塌了。

    “活下来了？”

    苏余有些意外。

    塌方时他在最里面，顶上砸下来的石头少说有千斤，按理说他该被砸成肉泥才对。

    可他没死。

    不仅没死，他感觉自己的身体里多了点什么。

    那是种很玄的感觉，像是有什么东西在血管里流淌，不是血，比血更冷，更沉。

    他下意识闭眼。

    黑暗中，他“看见”了。

    他的识海深处，悬着一道淡金色的沙漏，沙漏中的细沙正在缓缓倒流——不是往下流，是往上回流。

    沙漏上方空空如也，下方已积了薄薄一层金粉。

    那些金粉，每一粒都是一个刻度，刻着他的命。

    他莫名就知道了这沙漏的名字。

    时间债务。

    这是诅咒，也是遗赠。

    上古时族曾妄图窃取天道时序，被天劫覆灭。

    时族血脉中的时间祖炁被天道改写为诅咒——活着的时族，必须向天道缴纳“时间税”。

    每日一息。

    一息是多长？

    《内经》有载：营卫之气昼夜运行五十周，每周二百七十息。

    昼夜合计一万三千五百息，一息约合常人四次呼吸。

    一日一息，看似微不足道，实则是在他寿命的沙漏上凿了一个看不见的孔。

    税有定额，债有利息。

    若他主动动用时间之力，消耗的每一息都是从寿命里硬生生挖出来的——那是债，不是税。

    每主动动用一次时间之力，无论消耗多少息，都会凝成一道黑痕。

    黑痕是罚金，满九道则天劫降临，届时不是扣阳寿，是收命。

    而天道扣税的那一息，并非毫无回报。

    每被动扣一息，得一点时痕。

    时痕累积，可强化肉身神魂，亦可凝成金痕。

    金痕是本金，满九道可抵一次天劫。

    这便是时族血脉的宿命。

    苏余睁开眼。

    他终于明白自己为什么能活下来了。

    塌方砸下来的瞬间，正好是子时——天道扣除时间的那一刻。
content_en:
black.

It's so dark that you can't even see your fingers.

Su Yu was forced to wake up by the burning pain in his chest.

He coughed, and his mouth was filled with rusty blood foam, mixed with cinders, and stuck to the base of his tongue.

Above the head is the collapsed rubble, and behind is the cold rock wall.

He remembered - the Xisan Mine collapsed.

"Survived?"

Su Yu was a little surprised.

He was inside when the collapse occurred, and the rocks that fell from the top weighed at least a thousand kilograms. It stands to reason that he should have been smashed into a pulp.

But he's not dead.

Not only was he not dead, he felt like there was something more in his body.

It was a very mysterious feeling, as if something was flowing in the veins, not blood, but colder and heavier than blood.

He closed his eyes subconsciously.

In the darkness, he "saw".

In the depths of his sea of ​​consciousness, a pale golden hourglass hung, and the fine sand in the hourglass was slowly flowing back—not downwards, but upwards.

The top of the hourglass is empty, but a thin layer of gold powder has accumulated below.

Each grain of gold powder is a scale, engraved with his life.

He somehow knew the name of this hourglass.

Time debt.

It’s a curse and a legacy.

In ancient times, the clan tried to steal the time order of heaven, but was destroyed by the catastrophe.

The Time Ancestral Qi in the blood of the Time Clan was rewritten as a curse by Heavenly Dao - the living Time Clan must pay "time tax" to Heavenly Dao.

One breath per day.

How long is a breath?

"Nei Jing" records: The Qi of Yingwei circulates for fifty weeks day and night, with two hundred and seventy breaths per week.

The total number of days and nights is 13,500 breaths, and one breath is equivalent to four breaths of an ordinary person.

One breath a day may seem insignificant, but in fact it cuts an invisible hole in the hourglass of his life.

Taxes have fixed amounts, and debts have interest.

If he takes the initiative to use the power of time, every breath he consumes will be dug out of his lifespan - it is a debt, not a tax.

Every time the power of time is actively used, no matter how much breath is consumed, a black mark will form.

The black mark is a fine, and when the nine paths are reached, a catastrophe will come. At that time, it will either deduct one's life span or take one's life.

And the breath of tax deduction from heaven is not without return.

Every time you passively deduct a breath, you will get a time mark.

The accumulation of time marks can strengthen the physical body and soul, and can also be condensed into golden marks.

The golden mark is the principal, and if it reaches nine levels, it can be used to cover one heavenly disaster.

This is the fate of the Shi Clan bloodline.

Su Yu opened his eyes.

He finally understood why he survived.

The moment when the landslide fell, it happened to be Zi Shi - the moment when the way of heaven deducted time.
